newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian soldier runs amok, kills five colleagues.
newsitem.headline: Indian soldier runs amok, kills five colleagues.

text.p: An Indian soldier ran amok with a gun on Wednesday killing five of his colleagues, including two officers, and wounding seven others, an army spokesman said.
The soldier, from the Rashtriya Rifles in Sopore, Jammu and Kashmir state, "ran amok and fired indiscriminately at his colleagues...before he was overpowered," the spokesman said.
Rashtriya Rifles is the counter-insurgency wing of the army, engaged in controlling a separatist rebellion by Moslem guerrillas in Kashmir, mainly Hindu India's only Moslem majority province.
Sopore is an apple-growing town 50 km (30 miles) north of Srinagar, summer capital of the Himalayan state, where more than 20,000 people have been killed since 1990 in violence linked to separatism.
"Preliminary investigations (suggest) the soldier was homesick or had some other domestic problem," the spokesman added.
